summary: Senior Manager, ALM Risk Modelling candidate: ~7 years across asset-liability management and interest rate risk modelling for institutional portfolios, including delegated sign-off on client ALM outputs at Moody's Analytics, ALM/LDI studies at Ortec Finance, and financial-risk transformation delivery at EY. Led design of a multi-asset cash flow projection engine embedding behavioural and prepayment assumptions; built stochastic scenario generators; holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Re-engineers legacy workflows into Python analytics pipelines with software-engineering discipline. CFA, dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering).
core_skills: Software Engineering Practices (Git, CI/CD, Code Review)

roles.title: Asst. Director - Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Balance Sheet Interest Rate Risk Modelling
bullets: Oversees interest rate risk and duration analysis for multi-asset institutional client portfolios under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.

Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction and spread calibration before production release.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming sensitivity and scenario consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Behavioural Cash Flow Modelling & Balance Sheet Projection
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, providing forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Embedded behavioural cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays into the projection models, aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Model Coding, Software Practices & Stakeholder Engagement
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, maintained under Git version control.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Prepares and presents analytical summaries on interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance sheet sensitivities for senior stakeholders, translating quantitative outputs into decision-ready narratives.
Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking, and documentation standards; escalates outputs lacking economic defensibility to clients' Heads of Risk.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds and asset managers on PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM, advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped development requests and validated model outputs post-deployment; migrated all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on data sourcing and model requirements.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators, calibrated to client assumptions, to quantify interest rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance sheet risk exposures.

Modelled actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment product types and economic variables; performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk.

Developed and validated, on a team of three, the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics for a three-plan university pension merger, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

Presented model findings and allocation proposals to pension-fund investment committees on-site; ran asset-only and surplus optimization on VaR and CVaR with risk decomposition using Ortec's GLASS platform.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
